uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Restores the Pokémon's HP and nullifies damage from Pokémon from the opposing team. This Ability goes on a 30s cooldown after it's triggered.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.

Has the user shoots 6 star-shaped rays in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit and reducing their movement speed by 35% for 0.3s. The user is slowed by 30% while casting this move. The slow duration is extended by 0.3s for each star that hits the same Pokémon.

Has the user continuously launch a huge volume of pressurized water in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit and shoves them for 0.1s. The move ends by unleashing a powerful blast of water, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit and shoves them for 1s. The user is slowed by 30% while casting this move. This move slows opposing Pokémon hit by 50% for 0.3s, further extended with each hit.
Has the user splash muddy water around itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon, slowing them by 30% for 1s, and throwing them for 0.6s.
Increases the duration of the slow by 1s.
Has the user charge in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit and shoves them for 0.25s. The distance this move travels is cut short when colliding into opposing Pokémon.

Vaporeon jumps in a designated direction, creating continuous waves centered around herself for 2.25s. Vaporeon and any ally Pokémon that come in contact with a wave gains a buff that lasts 1.5s, healing once every 0.5s. This buff on an ally can be refreshed every time they come in contact with a wave, healing up to a maximum of 7 times.
Increases the amount of HP restored.

Has the user cloak itself in water for up to 3s, reducing damage received by 15% and increasing movement speed by 40%, ramping up by 5% every 0.25s up to 60%. This move can be used again within 3s to charge in a designated direction, dealing damage and shoving opposing Pokémon for 0.6s before jumping back in the opposite direction and gaining a shield. Vaporeon cannot auto attack or cast other moves whiile cloaked in water.

Has the user jump up high and dive underwater, creating a current that pulls in nearby opposing Pokémon for 0.3s. Afterward, the user leaps out of the water, dealing damage to nearby opposing Pokémon and throws them for 1s.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
